create_ion_from_atoms: create an Ion object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing the ion structure
create_ion_from_db: create an Ion object by selecting a specific ion from the ion database using its index
create_ion_random: create an Ion object by randomly selecting an ion from the default ion database
get_ion_concentration: compute the ion concentration in molar units given a volume in Angstrom cubed
load_ion_from_dict: load ion fields including atoms, name, and charge from a dictionary into the Ion object
